claims.author: fanquake
claims.question: Why is one of the native Windows CI jobs failing to compile while the other is not?
claims.quote: Why is one of the native Windows jobs failing to compile: https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/actions/runs/16027562790/job/45219347987?pr=32857#step:10:553, but not the other: https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/actions/runs/16027562790/job/45219348012?pr=32857 ?

status_by.quote: because it's in the fuzzer code, I incorrectly changed one of the function signatures there.

claims.status_note: author explained a function signature in fuzzer code was changed incorrectly

claims.author: rkrux
claims.quote: descriptorprocesspsbt also does signing, it won't be far fetched to allow this option in that RPC too.
claims.request: Add keypath_only option to descriptorprocesspsbt RPC since it also performs signing.

claims.author: rkrux
claims.quote: FinishTransaction is updated in this PR to have this option. It's used by send and sendall, so it seems reasonable to have this option in sendall too.
claims.request: Add keypath_only option to sendall RPC as well.

claims.author: rkrux
claims.quote: Along similar lines, sendmany and sendtoaddress also have similar expectations as send, which includes signing.
claims.request: Consider adding keypath_only to sendmany and sendtoaddress.

status_by.quote: Seems fine to me to not update them in this PR, they don't use the common internal signing/processing functions as well.

claims.status_note: reviewer agreed with author that older RPCs can be left alone

claims.author: rkrux
claims.quote: A new test case can be added there as well by not passing the nosign option and by instead passing this new option to not sign the script path.
claims.request: Add a test case in wallet_musig.py exercising keypath_only during the MuSig flow.

status_by.quote: Nice, the changes in the commit are cleaner than what I suggested.

claims.status_note: author pushed test coverage and reviewer accepted the implementation

claims.author: rkrux
claims.quote: I believe the changes in the multiple RPCs require a release note.
claims.request: Add a release note for the changes across multiple RPCs.
claims.status_note: author added a release note commit

claims.author: rkrux
claims.question: Is the PR description outdated regarding adding or removing taproot_scripts?

status_by.quote: Clarified in PR description as well code comments that we don't _add_ new taproot_scripts. We also don't _remove_ exiting ones, but don't _sign_ them.

claims.status_note: author clarified PR description and added code comments

claims.author: rkrux
claims.quote: If it gets merged before this PR (this one doesn't need to be dependent on it), it'd be really nice to use the ExtendedPrivate(|Public)Key class(es) from there so that we can have programmatic test cases generation
claims.request: Use ExtendedPrivateKey classes from PR #35543 to generate test keys programmatically instead of hardcoded extended keys.

status_by.quote: Rebased after #35543 and took advantage of it in the test, see https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/32857#discussion_r3485600298.

claims.status_note: author rebased after #35543 and used the generator in tests

claims.author: rkrux
claims.quote: Having both sign and keypath_only booleans might be confusing for the end user as the latter is a form of former.
claims.request: Avoid confusing overlapping boolean arguments in walletprocesspsbt (sign and keypath_only) by either using an enum or requiring sign to be true when keypath_only is true.

status_by.quote: I think it's better to keep similar RPC methods consistent, even if it's a bit awkward for one of them.

claims.status_note: author preferred keeping RPC arguments consistent across methods

claims.author: jeanpablojp
claims.quote: This return also blocks finalizing via script path with signatures already in the PSBT, not just signing new ones. With `keypath_only=true` and `finalize=true`, such a PSBT comes back `complete=false`.
claims.request: Note that keypath_only=true also prevents finalizing via existing script path signatures in the PSBT, returning complete=false.

status_by.quote: Clarified the documentation and added test coverage. I see `keypath_only=true` as a privacy / safety feature, so this behavior seems correct, even if surprising.

claims.status_note: author documented this behavior and added test coverage, explaining keypath_only acts as a privacy and safety feature

claims.author: jeanpablojp
claims.question: Is it intentional that fundrawtransaction and walletcreatefundedpsbt accept keypath_only without effect?
claims.quote: This list is shared with fundrawtransaction and walletcreatefundedpsbt, which never sign, so both now accept keypath_only with no effect (before, they rejected it). Intentional?

status_by.quote: I ended up adding support to `walletcreatefundedpsbt`, rather than suppressing the argument. `fundrawtransaction` now throws if you set it

claims.status_note: author added support to walletcreatefundedpsbt and made fundrawtransaction throw
